text:
- **Record layer views:** The owner chose Model A for the record layer design. The site now renders the records branch and a page for each draft version.
- **Owner questions and replies:** Ask-tool questions can now be answered on the site or in chat. Question endings now come only from hook events.
- **AGENTS.md grading:** The AGENTS.md check gives the same verdict on every rerun. Pull requests grade in diff mode, and full grading runs daily on main.
- **pm tooling and CI:** pm no longer installs a post-checkout git hook. The macOS Go jobs now run on a daily schedule only.
